name: M144395745L-zoom
title: LROC NAC M144395745L (~280 m pit zoom), emission 50.51 deg, incidence 47.91 deg, 0.81 m/px
note: THE famous oblique: spacecraft slewed so emission is 50.5 deg, incidence 47.9 deg (Nov 2010). Looks into the pit at the sunlit wall and shows the stacked layers of mare basalt flows (layer bands of a few metres) and the overhang lip. Raw camera geometry: the wall is foreshortened. Calibrated CDR, raw camera geometry resampled to ground-scale pixels and flipped to roughly north-up (not orthorectified).
licence: Public domain (LROC PDS products; NASA imagery). Credit NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University.
